name: Yunfeng Financial Group Limited
summary: Yunfeng Financial Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides insurance products in Hong Kong and Macao. The company operates in two segments, Insurance Business; and Other Financial Services and Corporate. It provides life and medical insurance, annuities, pensions, and mandatory provident fund schemes. The company also offers fund and asset management services, as well as financing and investing solutions. In addition, the company engages in the securities brokerage, custodian and other, financial technology, and principal investment businesses.
